directives.name: Gathering Strength
directives.title: Gathering Strength
directives.desc:
The Black League now stands united. The elements of decay, sloth, and decadence have been shorn from our state, and the groundwork laid for the machine that must be forged. Under the leadership of Glavkoverkh Yazov, our internal matters are dealt with, and it is time to look to Russia itself.

Western Siberia awaits us, filled with communists and criminals, vultures picking over the corpse of the Soviet Union. They offer lies to the people, be they reclaiming a past glory, or simply keeping rule by force. They are incapable of unifying Russia - only the Black League possesses this vision, and the will to execute it.

Yet before this, we must prepare. We must address the weaknesses and deficiencies of our state, and ready our people not just for the reclamation of Russia - but the Great Trial itself.

directives.name: Top-Down Reorganization
directives.title: Top-Down Reorganization
directives.desc:
If the state is a machine, then the bureaucracy is the engine. If it is a body, then it is is the beating heart. The fate of nations rests not merely on their soldiers - but those who control the levers of state power itself. Russia is littered with examples of this; states compromised by corruption, inefficiency, and disorganization.

We will not suffer this indignance.

The current administration of the Black League is a solid foundation - but foundations are insufficient. It must be improved, streamlined, and expanded. As more of Russia returns to the Black League, we must ensure that our state is prepared for the burden that will entail.

directives.name: Ashes of the Past, Made Anew
directives.title: Ashes of the Past, Made Anew
directives.name_en: Ashes of the Past, Made Anew
directives.title_en: Ashes of the Past, Made Anew
directives.desc:
The Siberian Plan holds significant promise, and is certainly one of the more useful legacies of the defunct Soviet Union. While Bukharin may have intended this for use by a communist state, much of what he planned can be appropriated for the League.

However, it requires adjustments.

There are numerous flaws and inefficiencies in the original Siberian Plan, ones that Glavkoverkh Yazov has ordered be immediately corrected. Work is already beginning to refine it into a more streamlined, efficient, and integrated tool of our state. The Soviet Union may be dead, but her corpse shall assist in bringing an end to the German regime.

directives.name: The Drums of War
directives.title: The Drums of War
directives.desc:
The Great Patriotic War broke the back of the Russian nation, and sent us reeling decades into the past. It was a humiliation that can only be avenged in blood; an incalculable catastrophe; a demonstration of incompetence and failure that can only be marveled at.

It is also a lesson we can learn from.

As we prepare once more to face the German regime, we must understand not merely what failed in this First Trial - but why it failed. We must understand the decisions each side made. We must appraise the battles won and lost, and compare numbers of logistics and orders of battle. We must extract every lesson possible, for our second war against Germany approaches.

And there will not be a third.

directives.name: Our Authority Secured
directives.title: Our Authority Secured
directives.desc:
The flag of the Black League flies proudly over Western Siberia.

Under the leadership of Glavkoverkh Yazov, we have been able to subjugate the petulant warlords and illegitimate states of the region, and now must begin the difficult process of assimilation. Despite coming from a single state, with a nation many believed on its deathbed, the Black League has shown that it possesses the will and capability to unite Russia.

For now, our authority is unchallenged, even as foes to our east and west rise. Our work is far from over, and it now falls to Glavkoverkh Yazov to determine the next steps the Black League will take. An important step on the road to unification has been achieved - one that brings us ever closer to the Great Trial.

directives.name: Our Soldiers Above All
directives.title: Our Soldiers Above All
directives.desc:
When the Great Trial commences, it will not be bureaucrats who march to liberate Moscow. It will not be the merchants who set the German butchers aflame. It will not be the teachers who protect the Russian people against the Nazi horde, and it will not be the workers who will cast down the eagle from atop the Reichstag.

It will be the soldiers of the Black League.

Our soldiers protect our borders, liberate our people from warlords, train our children in the ways of war, enforce our laws against the criminal, and stand as a symbol of defiance against the German regime. It will be they who liberate Russia - and we shall make sure that when the Great Trial concludes, that all of Russia knows that they are her saviors.

directives.name: Delineate Administrative Regions
directives.title: Delineate Administrative Regions
directives.desc:
Previously, we have maintained a primitive system of administration. One where administrative regions were drawn arbitrarily with no regard for its actual demographics or industrial makeup. One where administrators were given roles out of nepotism or shuffled away as political punishment. This inefficient, wasteful, and incompetent system will be abolished, and a new one built in its place.

Regions will now be determined through a methodology that takes into account the population size, industrial capacity, local terrain, and resource potential of an area. When these numbers are met, an administrative region will be established, led by an appointed commissar - one who is dedicated, qualified, and loyal. This will result in a more functional, capable, and adaptive bureaucracy - and one which can be easily expanded in the future.

directives.name: Listening from the Shadows
directives.title: Listening from the Shadows
directives.desc:
The Great Trial can afford no mistakes. The Black League can have no weak links. Russia cannot suffer further disloyalty. Weakness lies everywhere, and it takes little for weak links to become traitors. There is no difference between a soldier who sells information to an enemy, and a citizen spreading communist lies. Both undermine the state. Both threaten its control. Both pose risks.

Risks cannot be taken. Weaknesses cannot be tolerated. Leniency cannot be given.

One weak link can spell our defeat, and so we must be continually vigilant. We must watch all - merchants, parents, teachers, and even our soldiers. Trust is simply a luxury that cannot be afforded. And so we will find, expose, and ultimately purge every weak link within the Black League - without hesitation or question.

directives.name: Streamline Agricultural Output
directives.title: Streamline Agricultural Output
directives.desc:
As we begin expanding deeper into Russia, the systems that served us while we only controlled the region of Omsk are no longer sufficient. The agricultural output was enough to sustain our own people, but it is incapable of providing for the thousands who will be incorporated into the League when we expand.

To address this, Glavkoverkh Yazov has ordered an immediate review of the current agricultural practices - and has commanded that these methods must be streamlined, improved, or expanded to increase output enough to where we do not have to fear a shortage.

It will do little good for us to control Siberia, if we condemn ourselves to starvation in the process.

directives.name: Urban Industrial Development
directives.title: Urban Industrial Development
directives.desc:
War demands much of a nation. It demands parts, tools, bullets, guns, uniforms, boots, crates, and numerous other materials and pieces that are not appreciated until they are missing. Unless we want to realize halfway through our conquest of Siberia that we lack the supplies to conquer the other half, we must acknowledge that our industrial capability is insufficient - and subsequently addressed.

By order of Glavkoverkh Yazov, all existing industrial factories will be placed under the administration of the state, and new ones built across our territory to aid the war effort. While some civilian goods will be allowed to be produced, it will only be those that are necessary for survival.

The Black League marches to war, and it shall be with the full might of our industry behind them.

directives.name: A Steady Hand, A Concrete Will
directives.title: A Steady Hand, A Concrete Will
directives.name_en: A Steady Hand, A Concrete Will
directives.title_en: A Steady Hand, A Concrete Will
directives.desc:
To forge soldiers of the Black League, one must not simply instill mere skill - but also resolve. The armies of warlords are incomparable to the German war machine. The depravity of mercenaries is little compared to the systemic slaughter and brutality of Germans.

We must ensure our soldiers are prepared, in body and mind, to face and slay the German monster. We will push not just their physical limits, but their mental ones as we expose them to what the Germans will do to our people if they fail. Their discipline will be iron, as they are taught the skills of sabotage, assassination, and biological warfare.

These efforts will ensure that when the order is given to march into the German hell, they will do so without fear, and execute orders without hesitation as Russia is finally avenged.

directives.name: Rapid Supply Replenishment
directives.title: Rapid Supply Replenishment
directives.desc:
A review of our supply lines has revealed a grim limitation - while they are capable of supplying our armies, it is only in the event of minimal or limited operations. They are not optimized or prepared for the large-scale warfare that will be necessitated to reclaim Siberia - let alone Russia.

This will be immediately addressed, per directive of Glavkoverkh Yazov.

All existing routes will be categorized by order of importance, with the most critical being addressed first for expansion and modernization, and this will be repeated down this list. directives.name: Salvation For Those Worthy
directives.title: Salvation For Those Worthy
directives.desc:
The Redemptionary Brigades have served a useful purpose for a long time - but should the strict criteria continue to be applied, they will provide a lower and lower percentage of our forces over time until they become useless. Right now, they are reserved for among the worst of our prisoners - but the redemption offered can be expanded.

There are plenty of other criminals who have uses beyond hard labor - particularly rival soldiers who now languish in cells. There are political enemies as well, who cling to forbidden and failed ideologies, who can yet learn a better path. The Redemptionary Brigades only need those who are able to serve Russia.

If any of these people truly believe in serving Russia, let us give them the opportunity to prove it.

directives.name: Silence For Those Lost
directives.title: Silence For Those Lost
directives.desc:
There are those who question the path the Black League has taken. Some do so out of cowardice. Some out of selfishness. Some fear, and some ideology. For a variety of reasons, they stand opposed to the League and Glavkoverkh Yazov. They stand opposed to our vision of a united Russia, and Germany brought to her knees. Their reasons do not matter. Through their opposition, they have revealed themselves as our enemies.

Their meetings will be discovered and silenced. Their rallies will be crushed. Their sympathizers in our ranks purged. Their propaganda expunged. Imprisonment, public humiliation, and execution will be methodically employed to not merely break their movements, but destroy their spirits.

They are traitors, and they shall receive a traitor's due.

directives.name: The Most Basic Human Need
directives.title: The Most Basic Human Need
directives.desc:
An army runs on its stomach, and there is nothing that will break an army faster than hunger. Even the most disciplined man will become a ravenous animal when driven mad from hunger. Unless we wish to risk our soldiers becoming animals, we must ensure they always have enough food on-hand to survive until reinforcements come - or acquire food themselves.

This will be addressed in two ways - the first solution will be increasing the amount of rations given to each unit, and optimizing the rations given to individual soldiers to prevent as much waste as possible.

The second solution will be training a select number of soldiers in each unit how to properly hunt. If we cannot provide our soldiers with food in the worst case scenario, then we must give them the tools to acquire it themselves.

directives.name: Connect the Heart and Body
directives.title: Connect the Heart and Body
directives.desc:
Since the formation of the Black League, Omsk has served as the center of our nation; a role that it will maintain long into the future. However, our territory is more than just our capital, and if we are to fully restore Russia, it must be reconnected.

To this end, construction will begin on roads and railways connecting cities to Omsk. Where such infrastructure exists, it will be restored. Where it does not, it will be built. And when this project concludes, all of our nation will be connected to the new capital of Russia; the heart of our nation which shall provide to her people.

directives.name: Calculated Urban Reconstruction
directives.title: Calculated Urban Reconstruction
directives.desc:
Right now, many cities merely function as places to live, and designed with no ulterior purpose in mind. They are inefficiently structured, poorly mapped, and easily exploitable by enemies. These are cities for peace, not war.

They are certainly not cities prepared for the Great Trial.

These deficiencies must be corrected. The reconstruction of these cities will be meticulously planned, with specific attention paid to strategic supply depots, logistics routes, troop corridors, and static defenses. When we are finished, these will no longer just be simply cities.

They will be fortresses.

directives.name: League Air Wings
directives.title: League Air Wings
directives.desc:
While we focus on our army and the ground war, we cannot ignore the criticality of the air in the wars to come.

We can never forget the German bombers which shrieked over our cities and lands, reigning down terror on our people; terror for which we had no response. The Black League has been without a true air force for too long, and Glavkoverkh Yazov has ordered that a dedicated air force be established to rectify this.

This new air force will possess the best planes the League can provide. The pilots will be drilled daily, training ranges will be established for practice runs, and recruitment programs will be created to ensure a steady supply of pilots. As the Black League marches, our armies will be supported by the black wings of the League in the skies.

directives.name: For the Honor of Russia
directives.title: For the Honor of Russia
directives.desc:
The Russian identity is one that has been mangled and brutalized. It was a victim of the Tsars, the Soviets, and then suffered a traumatizing blow at the hands of Germany. Our people must be reminded of their honor - and what has been done to us.

We will lay bare the abuse that has been done to Russia. We will show them them the razed cities and piles of corpses, we will reveal the systemic genocide of Russians, and we will show them the crowds of Germans, united in their ideology of evil.

We will sear each atrocity of Germany into the minds of our citizens until they realize that only a united people can stand against this foe. When the Great Trial begins, and the Germans unite behind the swastika, Russians must similarly unite behind the Black League - and not cease until Germany is ashes.

directives.name: Excise the Vice of Corruption
directives.title: Excise the Vice of Corruption
directives.desc:
There is little that can cripple an army worse than corruption, nepotism, and the poison of cliques. Such cliques of officers dominated the Black League for years, contributing to its long decline. Were it not for Glavkoverkh Yazov, they would have ensured the end of the League. Never again can this rot be allowed to fester.

From now on, every single officer will be watched. No more will promotions be given as favors or bribery, but through strict merit and loyalty. Commissars will conduct regular reviews of officer conduct, and officers will be regularly moved across the army after a defined period of time. And through all of this, if any officer is found to be contributing to corruption of this sort?

They will be made an example of.

directives.name: One Drip of Sweat Means One Bullet
directives.title: One Drip of Sweat Means One Bullet
directives.name_en: One Drip of Sweat Means One Bullet
directives.title_en: One Drip of Sweat Means One Bullet
directives.desc:
The industry of our nation roars, but the output is not sufficient for our needs. While our factories pump out equipment, our workers toil long hours, the numbers show that it is not enough. More must be done if our armies are to be fully supplied. Glavkoverkh Yazov has made the decision to increase military production - effective immediately.

All production lines that are not dedicated to producing military equipment are to be immediately converted to support the effort. All production of civilian goods falls under this mandate, and any existing lines are to be expanded if possible. While this is another sacrifice our citizens must endure, it is one that will only be temporary.

For soon, all of Siberia will fall to the Black League.

directives.name: Extraction By Need, Not Profit
directives.title: Extraction By Need, Not Profit
directives.desc:
If the communists had a singular virtue, it was in their hatred of capitalist greed. There are little more disgusting vermin in Russia than those who would pillage from her natural resources, and personally profit from the wealth she offers her people. These vultures have made themselves rich by selling Russia resources back to her own people at obscene prices, or worse, to foreigners.

This treason will not be tolerated.

These profiteers will be dealt with. Examples will be made out of them, while their industries and corporations are seized by the Black League. We will put them to work extracting the resources - but now the wealth or Russia will go to her people, not the pockets of capitalists.

OMS_gathering_strength.title: Gathering Strength
OMS_gathering_strength.desc:
The Black League now stands united. The elements of decay, sloth, and decadence have been shorn from our state, and the groundwork laid for the machine that must be forged. Under the leadership of Glavkoverkh Yazov, our internal matters are dealt with, and it is time to look to Russia itself.

Western Siberia awaits us, filled with communists and criminals, vultures picking over the corpse of the Soviet Union. They offer lies to the people, be they reclaiming a past glory, or simply keeping rule by force. They are incapable of unifying Russia - only the Black League possesses this vision, and the will to execute it.

Yet before this, we must prepare. We must address the weaknesses and deficiencies of our state, and ready our people not just for the reclamation of Russia - but the Great Trial itself.

The Black League now stands united. The elements of decay, sloth, and decadence have been shorn from our state, and the groundwork laid for the machine that must be forged. Under the leadership of Glavkoverkh Yazov, our internal matters are dealt with, and it is time to look to Russia itself.

Western Siberia awaits us, filled with communists and criminals, vultures picking over the corpse of the Soviet Union. They offer lies to the people, be they reclaiming a past glory, or simply keeping rule by force. They are incapable of unifying Russia - only the Black League possesses this vision, and the will to execute it.

OMS_topdown_reorganization.name: Top-Down Reorganization
OMS_topdown_reorganization.title: Top-Down Reorganization
OMS_topdown_reorganization.desc:
If the state is a machine, then the bureaucracy is the engine. If it is a body, then it is is the beating heart. The fate of nations rests not merely on their soldiers - but those who control the levers of state power itself. Russia is littered with examples of this; states compromised by corruption, inefficiency, and disorganization.

We will not suffer this indignance.

The current administration of the Black League is a solid foundation - but foundations are insufficient. It must be improved, streamlined, and expanded. As more of Russia returns to the Black League, we must ensure that our state is prepared for the burden that will entail.

OMS_ashes_of_the_past_made_anew.name: Ashes of the Past, Made Anew
OMS_ashes_of_the_past_made_anew.title: Ashes of the Past, Made Anew
OMS_ashes_of_the_past_made_anew.name_en: Ashes of the Past, Made Anew
OMS_ashes_of_the_past_made_anew.title_en: Ashes of the Past, Made Anew
OMS_ashes_of_the_past_made_anew.desc:
The Siberian Plan holds significant promise, and is certainly one of the more useful legacies of the defunct Soviet Union. While Bukharin may have intended this for use by a communist state, much of what he planned can be appropriated for the League.

However, it requires adjustments.

There are numerous flaws and inefficiencies in the original Siberian Plan, ones that Glavkoverkh Yazov has ordered be immediately corrected. Work is already beginning to refine it into a more streamlined, efficient, and integrated tool of our state. The Soviet Union may be dead, but her corpse shall assist in bringing an end to the German regime.

OMS_mistakes_of_the_first_trial.name: The Drums of War
OMS_mistakes_of_the_first_trial.title: The Drums of War
OMS_mistakes_of_the_first_trial.desc:
The Great Patriotic War broke the back of the Russian nation, and sent us reeling decades into the past. It was a humiliation that can only be avenged in blood; an incalculable catastrophe; a demonstration of incompetence and failure that can only be marveled at.

It is also a lesson we can learn from.

As we prepare once more to face the German regime, we must understand not merely what failed in this First Trial - but why it failed. We must understand the decisions each side made. We must appraise the battles won and lost, and compare numbers of logistics and orders of battle. We must extract every lesson possible, for our second war against Germany approaches.

And there will not be a third.

OMS_our_authority_secured.name: Our Authority Secured
OMS_our_authority_secured.title: Our Authority Secured
OMS_our_authority_secured.desc:
The flag of the Black League flies proudly over Western Siberia.

Under the leadership of Glavkoverkh Yazov, we have been able to subjugate the petulant warlords and illegitimate states of the region, and now must begin the difficult process of assimilation. Despite coming from a single state, with a nation many believed on its deathbed, the Black League has shown that it possesses the will and capability to unite Russia.

For now, our authority is unchallenged, even as foes to our east and west rise. Our work is far from over, and it now falls to Glavkoverkh Yazov to determine the next steps the Black League will take. An important step on the road to unification has been achieved - one that brings us ever closer to the Great Trial.

OMS_our_soldiers_above_all.name: Our Soldiers Above All
OMS_our_soldiers_above_all.title: Our Soldiers Above All
OMS_our_soldiers_above_all.desc:
When the Great Trial commences, it will not be bureaucrats who march to liberate Moscow. It will not be the merchants who set the German butchers aflame. It will not be the teachers who protect the Russian people against the Nazi horde, and it will not be the workers who will cast down the eagle from atop the Reichstag.

It will be the soldiers of the Black League.

Our soldiers protect our borders, liberate our people from warlords, train our children in the ways of war, enforce our laws against the criminal, and stand as a symbol of defiance against the German regime. It will be they who liberate Russia - and we shall make sure that when the Great Trial concludes, that all of Russia knows that they are her saviors.

OMS_delineate_administrative_regions.name: Delineate Administrative Regions
OMS_delineate_administrative_regions.title: Delineate Administrative Regions
OMS_delineate_administrative_regions.desc:
Previously, we have maintained a primitive system of administration. One where administrative regions were drawn arbitrarily with no regard for its actual demographics or industrial makeup. One where administrators were given roles out of nepotism or shuffled away as political punishment. This inefficient, wasteful, and incompetent system will be abolished, and a new one built in its place.

Regions will now be determined through a methodology that takes into account the population size, industrial capacity, local terrain, and resource potential of an area. When these numbers are met, an administrative region will be established, led by an appointed commissar - one who is dedicated, qualified, and loyal. This will result in a more functional, capable, and adaptive bureaucracy - and one which can be easily expanded in the future.

OMS_listening_from_the_shadows.name: Listening from the Shadows
OMS_listening_from_the_shadows.title: Listening from the Shadows
OMS_listening_from_the_shadows.desc:
The Great Trial can afford no mistakes. The Black League can have no weak links. Russia cannot suffer further disloyalty. Weakness lies everywhere, and it takes little for weak links to become traitors. There is no difference between a soldier who sells information to an enemy, and a citizen spreading communist lies. Both undermine the state. Both threaten its control. Both pose risks.

Risks cannot be taken. Weaknesses cannot be tolerated. Leniency cannot be given.

One weak link can spell our defeat, and so we must be continually vigilant. We must watch all - merchants, parents, teachers, and even our soldiers. Trust is simply a luxury that cannot be afforded. And so we will find, expose, and ultimately purge every weak link within the Black League - without hesitation or question.

OMS_streamline_agricultural_output.name: Streamline Agricultural Output
OMS_streamline_agricultural_output.title: Streamline Agricultural Output
OMS_streamline_agricultural_output.desc:
As we begin expanding deeper into Russia, the systems that served us while we only controlled the region of Omsk are no longer sufficient. The agricultural output was enough to sustain our own people, but it is incapable of providing for the thousands who will be incorporated into the League when we expand.

To address this, Glavkoverkh Yazov has ordered an immediate review of the current agricultural practices - and has commanded that these methods must be streamlined, improved, or expanded to increase output enough to where we do not have to fear a shortage.

It will do little good for us to control Siberia, if we condemn ourselves to starvation in the process.

OMS_urban_industrial_development.name: Urban Industrial Development
OMS_urban_industrial_development.title: Urban Industrial Development
OMS_urban_industrial_development.desc:
War demands much of a nation. It demands parts, tools, bullets, guns, uniforms, boots, crates, and numerous other materials and pieces that are not appreciated until they are missing. Unless we want to realize halfway through our conquest of Siberia that we lack the supplies to conquer the other half, we must acknowledge that our industrial capability is insufficient - and subsequently addressed.

By order of Glavkoverkh Yazov, all existing industrial factories will be placed under the administration of the state, and new ones built across our territory to aid the war effort. While some civilian goods will be allowed to be produced, it will only be those that are necessary for survival.

The Black League marches to war, and it shall be with the full might of our industry behind them.

OMS_a_steady_hand_a_concrete_will.title: A Steady Hand, A Concrete Will
OMS_a_steady_hand_a_concrete_will.name_en: A Steady Hand, A Concrete Will
OMS_a_steady_hand_a_concrete_will.title_en: A Steady Hand, A Concrete Will
OMS_a_steady_hand_a_concrete_will.desc:
To forge soldiers of the Black League, one must not simply instill mere skill - but also resolve. The armies of warlords are incomparable to the German war machine. The depravity of mercenaries is little compared to the systemic slaughter and brutality of Germans.

We must ensure our soldiers are prepared, in body and mind, to face and slay the German monster. We will push not just their physical limits, but their mental ones as we expose them to what the Germans will do to our people if they fail. Their discipline will be iron, as they are taught the skills of sabotage, assassination, and biological warfare.

These efforts will ensure that when the order is given to march into the German hell, they will do so without fear, and execute orders without hesitation as Russia is finally avenged.

OMS_rapid_supply_replenishment.title: Rapid Supply Replenishment
OMS_rapid_supply_replenishment.desc:

There are political enemies as well, who cling to forbidden and failed ideologies, who can yet learn a better path. The Redemptionary Brigades only need those who are able to serve Russia.

If any of these people truly believe in serving Russia, let us give them the opportunity to prove it.

OMS_silence_for_those_lost.name: Silence For Those Lost
OMS_silence_for_those_lost.title: Silence For Those Lost
OMS_silence_for_those_lost.desc:
There are those who question the path the Black League has taken. Some do so out of cowardice. Some out of selfishness. Some fear, and some ideology. For a variety of reasons, they stand opposed to the League and Glavkoverkh Yazov. They stand opposed to our vision of a united Russia, and Germany brought to her knees. Their reasons do not matter. Through their opposition, they have revealed themselves as our enemies.

Their meetings will be discovered and silenced. Their rallies will be crushed. Their sympathizers in our ranks purged. Their propaganda expunged. Imprisonment, public humiliation, and execution will be methodically employed to not merely break their movements, but destroy their spirits.

They are traitors, and they shall receive a traitor's due.

OMS_the_most_basic_human_need.name: The Most Basic Human Need
OMS_the_most_basic_human_need.title: The Most Basic Human Need
OMS_the_most_basic_human_need.desc:
An army runs on its stomach, and there is nothing that will break an army faster than hunger. Even the most disciplined man will become a ravenous animal when driven mad from hunger. Unless we wish to risk our soldiers becoming animals, we must ensure they always have enough food on-hand to survive until reinforcements come - or acquire food themselves.

This will be addressed in two ways - the first solution will be increasing the amount of rations given to each unit, and optimizing the rations given to individual soldiers to prevent as much waste as possible.

The second solution will be training a select number of soldiers in each unit how to properly hunt. If we cannot provide our soldiers with food in the worst case scenario, then we must give them the tools to acquire it themselves.

OMS_connect_the_heart_and_body.name: Connect the Heart and Body
OMS_connect_the_heart_and_body.title: Connect the Heart and Body
OMS_connect_the_heart_and_body.desc:
Since the formation of the Black League, Omsk has served as the center of our nation; a role that it will maintain long into the future. However, our territory is more than just our capital, and if we are to fully restore Russia, it must be reconnected.

To this end, construction will begin on roads and railways connecting cities to Omsk. Where such infrastructure exists, it will be restored. Where it does not, it will be built. And when this project concludes, all of our nation will be connected to the new capital of Russia; the heart of our nation which shall provide to her people.

OMS_calculated_urban_reconstruction.name: Calculated Urban Reconstruction
OMS_calculated_urban_reconstruction.title: Calculated Urban Reconstruction
OMS_calculated_urban_reconstruction.desc:
Right now, many cities merely function as places to live, and designed with no ulterior purpose in mind. They are inefficiently structured, poorly mapped, and easily exploitable by enemies. These are cities for peace, not war.

They are certainly not cities prepared for the Great Trial.

These deficiencies must be corrected. The reconstruction of these cities will be meticulously planned, with specific attention paid to strategic supply depots, logistics routes, troop corridors, and static defenses. When we are finished, these will no longer just be simply cities.

They will be fortresses.

OMS_league_air_wings.name: League Air Wings
OMS_league_air_wings.title: League Air Wings
OMS_league_air_wings.desc:
While we focus on our army and the ground war, we cannot ignore the criticality of the air in the wars to come.

We can never forget the German bombers which shrieked over our cities and lands, reigning down terror on our people; terror for which we had no response. The Black League has been without a true air force for too long, and Glavkoverkh Yazov has ordered that a dedicated air force be established to rectify this.

This new air force will possess the best planes the League can provide. The pilots will be drilled daily, training ranges will be established for practice runs, and recruitment programs will be created to ensure a steady supply of pilots. As the Black League marches, our armies will be supported by the black wings of the League in the skies.

OMS_for_the_honor_of_russia.name: For the Honor of Russia
OMS_for_the_honor_of_russia.title: For the Honor of Russia
OMS_for_the_honor_of_russia.desc:
The Russian identity is one that has been mangled and brutalized. It was a victim of the Tsars, the Soviets, and then suffered a traumatizing blow at the hands of Germany. Our people must be reminded of their honor - and what has been done to us.

We will lay bare the abuse that has been done to Russia. We will show them them the razed cities and piles of corpses, we will reveal the systemic genocide of Russians, and we will show them the crowds of Germans, united in their ideology of evil.

We will sear each atrocity of Germany into the minds of our citizens until they realize that only a united people can stand against this foe. When the Great Trial begins, and the Germans unite behind the swastika, Russians must similarly unite behind the Black League - and not cease until Germany is ashes.

OMS_excise_the_vice_of_corruption.name: Excise the Vice of Corruption
OMS_excise_the_vice_of_corruption.title: Excise the Vice of Corruption
OMS_excise_the_vice_of_corruption.desc:
There is little that can cripple an army worse than corruption, nepotism, and the poison of cliques. Such cliques of officers dominated the Black League for years, contributing to its long decline. Were it not for Glavkoverkh Yazov, they would have ensured the end of the League. Never again can this rot be allowed to fester.

From now on, every single officer will be watched. No more will promotions be given as favors or bribery, but through strict merit and loyalty. Commissars will conduct regular reviews of officer conduct, and officers will be regularly moved across the army after a defined period of time. And through all of this, if any officer is found to be contributing to corruption of this sort?

They will be made an example of.

OMS_one_drip_of_sweat_means_one_bullet.name: One Drip of Sweat Means One Bullet
OMS_one_drip_of_sweat_means_one_bullet.title: One Drip of Sweat Means One Bullet
OMS_one_drip_of_sweat_means_one_bullet.name_en: One Drip of Sweat Means One Bullet
OMS_one_drip_of_sweat_means_one_bullet.title_en: One Drip of Sweat Means One Bullet
OMS_one_drip_of_sweat_means_one_bullet.desc:
The industry of our nation roars, but the output is not sufficient for our needs. While our factories pump out equipment, our workers toil long hours, the numbers show that it is not enough. More must be done if our armies are to be fully supplied. Glavkoverkh Yazov has made the decision to increase military production - effective immediately.

All production lines that are not dedicated to producing military equipment are to be immediately converted to support the effort. All production of civilian goods falls under this mandate, and any existing lines are to be expanded if possible. While this is another sacrifice our citizens must endure, it is one that will only be temporary.

For soon, all of Siberia will fall to the Black League.

OMS_extraction_by_need_not_profit.title: Extraction By Need, Not Profit

If the communists had a singular virtue, it was in their hatred of capitalist greed. There are little more disgusting vermin in Russia than those who would pillage from her natural resources, and personally profit from the wealth she offers her people. These vultures have made themselves rich by selling Russia resources back to her own people at obscene prices, or worse, to foreigners.

This treason will not be tolerated.

These profiteers will be dealt with. Examples will be made out of them, while their industries and corporations are seized by the Black League. We will put them to work extracting the resources - but now the wealth or Russia will go to her people, not the pockets of capitalists.

If the communists had a singular virtue, it was in their hatred of capitalist greed. There are little more disgusting vermin in Russia than those who would pillage from her natural resources, and personally profit from the wealth she offers her people. These vultures have made themselves rich by selling Russia resources back to her own people at obscene prices, or worse, to foreigners.

This treason will not be tolerated.
